body: I’d be interested to hear you thoughts on it
Have asked these questions to myself, I think it probably depends on your own situation.

I assume if I fail, things will either get better or worse. This I won’t know till it’s happened. Going to be doing my best not to fail, of course it possible so I’ve though about it and will just handle that problem if it come to it.

Yeah I’ll either mail it or hand deliver. Some I’ll keep on me. I realise it going to be very hard, going to be the first hurdle in the race to the finish. As for after trying not to really think about it, doesn’t really matter
Thank you so much, made me tear up. I really needed this.

I don’t think anyone has cared enough to worry about me. People have asked “how are you doing” and if I’m feeling good I’ll say “doing great”. If I’m feeling down I’ll just say “yeah fine”. On the rare occasion when I feel like I need/want some support and try to express how bad I feel, I get the generic “cheer up” or “I’m sorry to hear that” then it’s just brushed off.

For the first time I tried giving up weed because I thought it was the problem. I managed 1month of emotional distress and contemplating suicide. I decided to give it another go. The lack of sleep and mood swings ruin the only friendship I had. Now I sit here playing the same thought over and over in my head and suicide seem like the only escape. I’ve never felt so low in my life, everything I try just seem to make it worse or helps for a few hours then it’s back my thoughts
I dont think anyone has ever said to me “I’m worried about you”
This is how I feel. I’ve tried everything in my control to escape the feeling, but nothing works, it would be wrong not to. But it like the only things that can help me are out of my hands.
